notes: «قالا أخبرنا ابن وهب» joins the two co-transmitters into one level. Aisha relays the Prophet's words and is the last link.
«قال فقلت للقاسم أفرأيت الحية» is a second saying (Qasim's answer on the snake) whose asker is unnamed in the first person: needs_ruling (rule 11); not written as a group.
